translation_snapshot.source: Before you stands a tall figure, propped high by a serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is slim and muscular, and his face has an elven beauty to it, framed by locks of blonde hair. But there is a fierceness to this creature too, and his bright eyes veil a smouldering anger.
translation_snapshot.target: 在你的面前站着一位高大的生物，在他的腿部是像蛇一样的尾巴。他的身躯看起来高大威猛，并且他还有着一张精灵般美貌的脸庞和一头秀丽的长发。但同样的，这个生物也异常危险，你可以从他的眼睛中看到潜藏的愤怒。

translation_snapshot.source:
Until now, a certain game mechanic has been disabled. Go learn a new talent at the nearby Rune of Enlightenment and use it to blast each of the enemies in the next room. 

Can you identify the new mechanic?
translation_snapshot.target:
到目前为止，某项游戏机制一直处于禁用状态。去附近的启蒙符文处学习一项新技能，
并用它轰击下一个房间里的每个敌人。

你能辨认出这项新机制吗？

translation_snapshot.source: You tap into your golem's life energies to replenish your own. Drains %d life.
translation_snapshot.target: 你汲取傀儡的生命能量来恢复自己。恢复 %d 点生命。

translation_snapshot.source: You arrived in time and interrupted the ritual. The sorcerers have departed.
translation_snapshot.target: 你终于及时赶来阻止了仪式，法师们被驱散了。

translation_snapshot.source: The massive stone limb of the Rotting Titan, a mass of stone and rotting flesh. You think you can lift it, but it is very heavy.
translation_snapshot.target: 这是腐化泰坦的一部分沉重肢体，一大块腐烂的石化躯体。你认为你可以轻易举起它，但事实证明，它重的不可思议。

translation_snapshot.source: Zone-wide effect: The flames of the Fearscape increase all fire and blight damage by 10%, but the weird gravity reduces knockback resistance by 20%.
translation_snapshot.target: 地图效果 :  恶魔空间的火焰将增加 10% 火焰和枯萎伤害，同时减少 20% 击退抗性。
